question: Add history-window to the limits[].kind vocabulary, and to binding? It would name how far back a free tier reaches: Massive Stocks Basic 2 years of end-of-day bars, an Alpha Vantage free key the latest 100 daily points, a Finnhub free key 1 year of company news, 1 month of the earnings calendar and 4 quarters of EPS surprises.
why: limits[].kind has seven terms and none names a read depth. retention-clamped means stored bytes expire or the server shortens a request, which is not how far back a query tier answers. The depth sits unclassified in limits_note or extras.history_depth on massive, alpha-vantage (as a per-object-cap row), finnhub, coingecko, marketstack, financial-modeling-prep, tiingo, currents-api, gnews and newsapi.
